headline: Hungarian Parliament to Hold Extraordinary Session Next Week
summary: The Hungarian parliament will hold an extraordinary session next week. Proposals include cutting value-added tax on prescription medicines from 5% to zero, a move the government had already promised.
why: Changes to VAT rates alter government tax revenue and the cost of medicines, affecting public finances and the pharmaceutical sector.
